work.title: Shrek
work.note: Shrek, de 2001, é uma animação da DreamWorks baseada no livro ilustrado de William Steig, de 1990. A obra conversa com o foco porque a aula transforma esse contexto em descrever: He is tall. She has long hair. He has a mustache. She is slim. A referência mostra um ogro alto e uma princesa de cabelo comprido: “He is tall. She has long hair.”.

facts.sub: Use o verbo base para dar instruções: Take the green line. Get off at Market Street. Pergunte How many stops is it?

facts.label: Pegue
facts.sub: Para dar um passo, use o verbo base no começo: Take the green line. Go down the stairs. Buy a ticket. Não use you antes do verbo. Fale de modo curto e claro.

pages.title: A busy subway · 1/3
paragraphs: It is Saturday morning in the center of Manchester. People walk fast to the subway. Eva stands at the top of the stairs. Her friend Iris is with her. Eva is new in the city. She wants to go downtown alone.
“Eva, are you ready to take the subway?” says Iris. “Yes, but I’m a little nervous. How many stops is it?” says Eva. “It is six stops. Take the green line.” says Iris.
